summary.en: Ono combines oncology filings and label expansions with internally developed gastric-cancer and neuroscience candidates. Licensed late-stage immunology and hematology programs broaden the portfolio.
summary.zh: Ono 将肿瘤领域的申报和适应症扩展,与自主研发的胃癌和神经科学候选药物相结合。已获许可的后期免疫和血液项目拓宽了产品组合。

ind.en: CNS lymphoma in the US and Japan; also Phase 3 pemphigus
ind.zh: 美国和日本的中枢神经系统淋巴瘤;另有天疱疮 III 期

ind.en: Fourth-line GIST in Japan; also Phase 3 mutation-selected second-line GIST
ind.zh: 日本四线 GIST;另有突变选择的二线 GIST III 期

ind.en: Anaplastic thyroid cancer with lenvatinib in Japan
ind.zh: 日本与 lenvatinib 联用治疗间变性甲状腺癌

ind.en: First-line gastric cancer; also Phase 2 colorectal cancer
ind.zh: 一线胃癌;另有结直肠癌 II 期
IgA 肾病;另有膜性肾病

ind.en: Pediatric partial-onset seizures; also generalized tonic-clonic seizures
ind.zh: 儿童部分性发作癫痫;另有全面强直-阵挛发作

ind.en: Postherpetic neuralgia; also fibromyalgia and interstitial cystitis
ind.zh: 带状疱疹后神经痛;另有纤维肌痛和间质性膀胱炎

watch.en: Tirabrutinib CNS lymphoma and nivolumab thyroid-cancer applications are filed; ONO-4578 and ONO-2808 entered Phase 3.
watch.zh: Tirabrutinib 治疗中枢神经系统淋巴瘤和 nivolumab 治疗甲状腺癌的申请已提交;ONO-4578 和 ONO-2808 已进入 III 期。

watch.en: ONO-1110 missed primary endpoints in three pain-related Phase 2 studies; further studies are planned based on subgroup/exploratory signals.
watch.zh: ONO-1110 在三项疼痛相关 II 期研究中未达到主要终点;基于亚组/探索性信号,计划开展进一步研究。

watch.en: Povetacicept, sapablursen and BHV-1300 are licensed from Vertex, Ionis and Biohaven, respectively.
watch.zh: Povetacicept、sapablursen 和 BHV-1300 分别从 Vertex、Ionis 和 Biohaven 获得许可。
